redesign_intent: Preserve the streaming-app metaphor while making it truthful, recruiter-first, distinctive, accessible, responsive, and performant
v1_scope: Complete recruiter-first v1 with static typed content, recruiter-first Home and Artist experience, evidence-rich case-study tracks, silent guided Career Mix, Search and Library, Proof Waveform identity, responsive artwork, SEO, accessibility, analytics, and performance gates; no CMS or recorded narration
architecture: React Router 7 Framework Mode with static prerendering for Home, Artist, collections, and case-study routes; preserve existing public URLs and client navigation
libraries: Migrate from framer-motion 12 to Motion 13 with LazyMotion; retain and expand Darshify's original inline icon system; do not add a second animation runtime or Lucide
ui_architecture: Artist profile to proof tracks to conversion: first viewport establishes role, value, sourced evidence, CV, Email, and LinkedIn; Spotify components organize deeper portfolio content
front_loaded_ux_wins: Truth and conversion: remove fabricated signals and surface CV, Email, and LinkedIn in the first viewport
Proof-driven identity: real artifacts, evidence-rich case studies, and the Proof Waveform signature
Accessibility and mobile: semantic controls, visible focus, WCAG behavior, and first-view mobile conversion
test_coverage: At least 90% coverage on new and modified code, plus route, keyboard, accessibility, responsive, and critical-flow browser tests
release_strategy: Validate the complete redesign in a private preview deployment, then perform one atomic production cutover with a known rollback point
performance_contract: Use O(1) direct item lookup, O(n) search and filtering, O(n log n) only for explicit sorting, no global 60fps state updates, and keep interaction work below 50ms
accessibility_target: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA with automated axe checks and manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, touch-target, and reduced-motion verification
career_mix: The global Play action launches a truthful silent 60-second guided recruiter tour with progress, pause, previous, next, and deep links to supporting evidence
